scope: Self-directed product usability audit of the built app, using synthetic accounts and real local auth/API/SQL. Desktop 1280x720 and phone 390x844.
accounts: four-inspiration account with seeded reading and principles
2002-inspiration account with a public group member

findings.observed: On populated Home, the first three Tab stops were Principle buttons above the visible viewport. They were also exposed in the accessibility tree.
findings.fix: Make inactive spatial sections inert and hidden from accessibility until they become active. Preserve intentional focus when moving between sections.

findings.observed: The 2002-item archive displayed 2000 unlabeled orbs, without readable titles, snippets, or dates in the main view.
findings.fix: Provide a readable browsing view with snippets and dates; retain the spatial view as an optional view. Show recent inspirations before a search term is entered.

findings.observed: An empty Inspirations screen showed an otherwise blank field and a Revisit your inspirations button. Clicking it opened Nothing to review yet.
findings.fix: Show a clear empty-state explanation and one Capture action; hide Revisit when there is nothing to revisit.

findings.observed: One-character queries produced neither results nor explanatory feedback. In Bo’s public view, searching destination returned nothing although Bo’s visible public inspiration contained that word; the search is scoped to the viewer’s own profile.
findings.fix: Show recent items for an empty query and explain any query-length requirement. In a member or room view, search the visible public collection with an explicit scope.

findings.observed: The return caret had an approximately 8.5px visible bounding box, inherited rgba(232,237,244,0.3), and its own opacity of 0.8. Its button hit target was larger.
findings.fix: Increase the visible caret size and resting contrast; optionally show its destination label.

findings.observed: Capture offers Share with rooms and a general explanation, but does not identify the rooms or explain all-room scope; the choice is also offered on an account with no rooms.
findings.fix: Use explicit all-room wording, expose the audience names/count, and explain visibility when the account has no rooms.
